_disclaimer: PROVISIONAL CONFIGURATION -- NOT CLINICALLY VALIDATED, AND NOT ESTABLISHED AS REPRESENTATIVE OF CONVENTIONAL PRACTICE. Baseline thresholds below are placeholders chosen only to make the two comparison baselines runnable and testable. Per ICAIRE_Simulation_Validation_Methodology.md section 4a (Revision 2), the moving-average baseline's characterization as 'conventional practice' is explicitly withdrawn pending a citation -- do not present either baseline's threshold as evidence-based until the corresponding parameter registry row (section 9) is resolved.

baseline_0_always_normal.description: Never flags any minute. A sanity floor, not a threshold.
baseline_0_always_normal.registry_row: n/a -- trivial comparator, no numeric parameter

baseline_2_fixed_threshold.description: Instantaneous per-reading comparison against a fixed multiple of the engine's own baseline for that room/procMult. No averaging window, no confirmation window.

baseline_3_moving_average.description: A fixed-window moving average of readings compared against a fixed multiple of the engine's own baseline. No confirmation window.
